aureole.gui.title: Aureole
aureole.gui.reset.tip: Restore every setting to the default (the classic red ring).
aureole.gui.palette.tip:
Left-click: primary colour
Right-click: secondary colour
aureole.section.no_style_options: This style has no extra options.
aureole.section.static_hint: The ring stays put. Try Scan, Halo, Ripple or Gyro!
aureole.section.trail_needs_scan: §7The trail follows the Scan motion — switch Motion to Scan to see it.
aureole.section.privacy: §7100% client-side visuals: no packets, no game changes.
aureole.msg.bad_code: Clipboard doesn't contain an Aureole share code
aureole.preset.classic.tip: The ring from your video: a thin soft-red line, 3 blocks wide, at your feet.
aureole.preset.classic_scan.tip: The classic red line sweeping feet-to-head with a fading red smear.
aureole.preset.angelic.tip: A glowing golden halo floating above your head, with drifting light motes.
aureole.preset.scanner.tip: Sci-fi body scan: cyan-to-violet ring hugging your silhouette with a rainbow trail.
aureole.preset.inferno.tip: Flickering fire curtain with embers rising off it.
aureole.preset.frost.tip: Twinkling ice orbs riding a gentle wave.
aureole.preset.void.tip: A breathing dark-purple disc with violet helix strands.
aureole.preset.toxic.tip: Three stacked dashed rings spinning with a green comet, plus rising spores.
aureole.preset.sakura.tip: Soft pink ripples spreading out like petals on water, with jump rings.
aureole.preset.aurora.tip: Northern-lights curtain drifting through teal and violet.
aureole.preset.rainbow.tip: A smooth rainbow scanner with matching echoes.
aureole.preset.radar.tip: A green sonar disc with a sweeping beam, plus jump rings.
aureole.option.line_width.tip: Thickness in pixels (at 1080p). Stays the same on screen at any distance.
aureole.option.height_offset.tip: Height above your feet, in blocks.
aureole.option.segments.tip: Number of segments around the circle.
aureole.option.spin_speed.tip: Rotation speed in degrees per second. Negative spins the other way.
aureole.option.ring_count.tip: Stack several copies of the ring vertically.
aureole.option.glow_width.tip: Width of the bloom around the line, in pixels.
aureole.option.lightning_intensity.tip: How wild the electric jitter is.
aureole.option.dash_count.tip: Number of dashes around the ring.
aureole.option.dash_fill.tip: Fraction of each dash that is drawn.
aureole.option.orb_count.tip: Number of orbs around the ring.
aureole.option.motion.tip: How the ring moves over time.
aureole.option.scan_direction.tip: Sweep up and down, only up, or only down.
aureole.option.scan_pause.tip: Seconds to rest at the top and bottom.
aureole.option.scan_min.tip: Bottom of the sweep (0 = feet, 1 = top of head).
aureole.option.scan_max.tip: Top of the sweep (0 = feet, 1 = top of head).
aureole.option.scan_contour.tip: Ring narrows around your head to hug your shape.
aureole.option.halo_bob.tip: How much the halo floats up and down.
aureole.option.wave_frequency.tip: Number of crests around the ring.
aureole.option.trail_enabled.tip: Fading trail that follows the scanning ring.
aureole.option.trail_style.tip: Smooth smear, echo rings, or both.
aureole.option.trail_length.tip: How far back in time the trail reaches.
aureole.option.trail_match_ring.tip: Use the ring's colours instead of the trail's own.
aureole.option.color_repeats.tip: How many times gradients/rainbows repeat around the ring.
aureole.option.embers.tip: Glowing motes drift up off the ring.
aureole.option.helix.tip: Orbs spiral around your body in a helix.
aureole.option.jump_rings.tip: A ring bursts outward on the ground when you jump or land.
aureole.option.speed_reactive.tip: Ring widens and brightens as you move faster.
aureole.option.speed_reactive_amount.tip: How strongly speed affects the ring.
aureole.option.damage_flash.tip: Off by default. Ring flashes and sends a shockwave when you take damage.
aureole.option.enabled.tip: Turn the whole mod on or off.
aureole.option.through_walls.tip: Draw on top of blocks (like the video) instead of being hidden by them.
aureole.option.show_first_person.tip: Show the halo in first person.
aureole.option.show_third_person.tip: Show the halo in third person.
aureole.option.hide_sneaking.tip: Hide the halo while you crouch.
aureole.option.hide_invisible.tip: Hide the halo while you have invisibility.
aureole.option.hidden_opacity.tip: With Through Blocks on: how visible the parts hidden behind blocks or your body are. 1.00 = everything on top (like the video); lower = more 3D.
aureole.preset.seraph.tip: A golden crown-halo above your head with twin spirals of light around you.
aureole.preset.storm.tip: A crackling electric ring that wobbles like a gyroscope.
aureole.preset.galaxy.tip: Four spiral arms of stars swirling at your feet.
aureole.option.text_enabled.tip: Show your own text around you.
aureole.option.text.tip: Up to 48 characters. Paste with Ctrl+V.
aureole.option.text_mode.tip: Orbit: letters wrap around the ring like a glowing band. Engraved: lying flat on the ground along the ring. Banner: floating above your head, always facing you.
aureole.option.text_height.tip: Height of orbiting text, or gap above your head for the banner.
aureole.option.text_speed.tip: Degrees per second the text travels around you.
aureole.option.text_repeat.tip: How many copies of the text go around the ring.
aureole.option.text_smooth_font.tip: Use the bundled smooth typeface instead of the blocky Minecraft font.
aureole.option.emblem_mode.tip: Floor: under you. Above: floating over your head. Back: upright behind you.
aureole.option.emblem_size.tip: Width of the image in blocks.
aureole.option.emblem_pulse.tip: Gentle breathing of the image's opacity. 0 = steady.
aureole.option.bloom.tip: Soft, additive glow around every visual element.
aureole.option.bloom_radius.tip: How far the glow spreads, in pixels at 1080p.
aureole.option.ring_bloom.tip: Glow amount for the ring itself.
aureole.option.trail_bloom.tip: Glow amount for the scan trail.
aureole.option.extras_bloom.tip: Glow on embers, helix, jump rings and shockwaves.
aureole.option.bloom_with_shaders.tip: Shaderpacks have their own bloom, and stacking both washes colours out to white, so the halo's glow pauses while a pack is active. Turn this on to keep it anyway.
aureole.option.shader_color_boost.tip: Extra saturation applied only while an Iris shaderpack is active, because some packs grade thin coloured lines towards white. 1.00 = off.
aureole.option.tag_enabled.tip: Show your own styled nametag above your head (third person). Only you see it.
aureole.option.tag_text.tip: What your nametag says. Empty = your username. Supports &-formatting codes and symbols.
aureole.option.tag_title.tip: An optional second line above your name.
aureole.option.tag_icon_size.tip: Size of the icons next to your name.
aureole.option.tag_background.tip: Dark plate behind the text, like vanilla nametags.
aureole.option.tag_smooth_font.tip: Use the smooth typeface instead of the Minecraft font.
aureole.option.tag_through_walls.tip: Faintly visible through blocks, like vanilla nametags.
aureole.option.tag_title_enabled.tip: Show or hide the title line without deleting it.
